messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — AeroFlux (acct AF-449) invoice INV-2026-043 for $18,750 is past due as of today. Customer reached out saying cashflow squeeze, asked about splitting payment. Do we have prior payment-plan history? @Jordan Li
Jordan Li: Not on a formal plan. We had a short-term extension back in Q2 for them (one-off). No open disputes that I see.
Maya Chen: OK. CS says they proposed a 3-way split. Want to confirm what we can approve without legal.
Tom (Billing): I can draft a standard split-pay term. Proposed:
```
- 50% now ($9,375) by 2025-12-01 (wire/ACH)
- 25% on 2026-01-15
- 25% on 2026-02-15
- Late fee waiver for first installment if paid on time
```
Need confirmation on whether we allow the 25% installments without collateral.
Rebecca Ortiz: I can approve that plan as long as CS gets a signed payment agreement and we get the initial 50% cleared before any service exceptions are removed. Also approve a one-time goodwill credit up to $1,250 for a disputed integration usage spike if documented.
Ava - CS: Customer accepted the split verbally and will sign. They also requested a usage credit — they claim a logging bug caused 2k extra tokens on a job. They asked for $1,250 back. Attached their logs in the ticket #TKT-4821.
Jordan Li: Can engineering confirm the spike? If it's our bug, credit it. If not, push them to pay and we can do payment plan + dispute review.
Tom (Billing): collections-bot just sent dunning notice #3 at 1955557200. I held suspension for 48h per CS until we finalize. If we approve credit, it reduces the balance to $17,500 and the installments recalculated accordingly.
collections-bot: Automatic reminder scheduled: payment-due (50% initial) on 2025-12-01. Next reminder 2025-11-25.
Maya Chen: Rebecca — can you sign-off on the $1,250 credit now or do you want legal looped in? If you approve, I'll update ledger and Tom will send new invoice.
Rebecca Ortiz: Approving $1,250 credit. Please include the clause "credit contingent on completion of signed payment agreement" in the doc.
Tom (Billing): Will draft the agreement and new invoice INV-2026-043-A with breakdown. Drafting now, will include payment methods (ACH preferred). Example ACH reference text:
```
Payee: Redwood Inference Inc.
Bank: First City Banking (test)
ABA: 111000111
Account: 000123456789
Reference: INV-2026-043-A / AF-449
```
(we don't paste these publicly; billing portal will provide real rails)
Ava - CS: Customer asked if we can delay enforcement of service suspension until 2026-01-05 instead of our usual 30 days. They promised the initial 50% on 12/01.
Maya Chen: I'm willing to set enforcement date to 2026-01-05 contingent on 50% clearing by 12/01 and signed agreement in 48 hours.
Jordan Li: Add a note to the account: "Payment plan approved w/ conditional suspension hold until 2026-01-05; initial payment required."
Tom (Billing): Agreement sent to customer via DocuSign at 1955558800. I also attached the recalculated schedule and the $1,250 credit line item.
collections-bot: DocuSign status: sent -> viewed at 1955559400.
Ava - CS: Customer viewed the DocuSign and asked one small tweak to the invoice description — asked to anonymize internal job IDs. I told them yes, billing will sanitize.
Rebecca Ortiz: Good. I'll route the finalized agreement to legal only if they request more lenient terms. Otherwise proceed.
Maya Chen: Summary plan: approve $1,250 usage credit; 3-installment payment plan (50/25/25); hold suspension until 2026-01-05 provided 50% clears by 2025-12-01 and signed agreement returned. Tom — confirm when funds clear and update ledger. Jordan — add the account note and flag for FYI on renewals.
Tom (Billing): Will monitor ACH/wire and post receipts. I put a follow-up reminder for 2025-12-02 to confirm initial payment.
collections-bot: Reminder scheduled: verify-initial-payment on 2025-12-02.
Maya Chen: Thanks team. If initial payment fails, escalate to legal and resume suspension immediately. :eyes:
